hints.content:
The function is increasing, so the left Riemann sum will underestimate the actual area:

![The graph of function f has the shaded area divided into 3 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top left corner and is below the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/5427accf6d3535bc8b59f8de8c99fe737ae2a153)

And the right Riemann sum will overestimate:

![The graph of function f has the shaded area divided into 4 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top right corner and rises above the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/659841a1746c4b35a7e17831b4d4f8128b20faa7)

Here are the areas ordered from least to greatest:

* Left Riemann sum
* Actual area under the curve
* Right Riemann sum
